questions.question: Which Indus Valley Civilization site is renowned for possessing a massive tidal dockyard?

questions.explanation: The bronze Dancing Girl masterpiece was excavated by Ernest Mackay at Mohenjo-daro in 1926.

questions.question: Which Gupta emperor is famously referred to as the 'Napoleon of India' by historian Vincent Smith?

questions.question: Which Sultan of Delhi introduced market control regulations and price monitoring officers (Shahna-i-Mandi)?

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Kudavolai electoral system of the Imperial Cholas documented in the Uttaramerur Inscriptions of Parantaka I (919 & 921 CE):
I. The village of Uttaramerur was divided into 30 wards (Kudumbus) for local self-governance.
II. Candidates had to own at least one-fourth veli of taxable land and possess a house built on their own site.
III. Candidates were required to be between 35 and 70 years of age and proficient in Vedic literature and commentaries.
IV. Women and men who had served on any committee for the previous three years were barred from contesting.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: All four clauses are historically authentic provisions recorded on the walls of the Vaikunta Perumal temple at Uttaramerur during the reign of Parantaka Chola I.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Ancient and Medieval South Indian Inscriptions / Texts) with List-II (Dynasties / Rulers):
List-I:
(a) Aihole Inscription of Ravikirti
(b) Uttaramerur Inscription
(c) Velvikudi Copper Plates
(d) Hathigumpha Inscription
List-II:
1. Parantaka Chola I
2. Pulakesin II (Chalukya)
3. Kharavela (Kalinga)
4. Nedunjadayan / Jatila Parantaka (Pandya)
Choose the correct code:
(a) - (b) - (c) - (d)
questions.explanation: Aihole = Pulakesin II; Uttaramerur = Parantaka Chola I; Velvikudi plates = Pandya ruler Nedunjadayan; Hathigumpha = King Kharavela of Kalinga.
